content:
harpreet: anyone else seeing a spike of OOMs on the Sparkline-13B canary after flipping batch_packing on? :thinking_face:

toni: yep, started ~14:02 UTC. OOMs only when we set max_new_tokens=64 and batch_packing=true on the int4 canary. CPU looks fine, GPU mem goes into the red.

lucy: can you paste a brief log/snippet?

toni: sure, from the pod that died:```
[2026-03-20T14:02:11Z] ERROR runtime: CUDA OOM when allocating 2.1GiB for attention_kv_cache
[2026-03-20T14:02:11Z] WARN runtime: observed kv_slots_in_use=0.92, kv_fragmentation=0.28, slot_reserve=0.1
[2026-03-20T14:02:11Z] ERROR inference: OOM at token 34 of response
```

eval-bot: perf-eval: quant=int4+pack -> latency 95p +12ms, token-cost -18%, quality delta (eval-suite-2026) BLEU-like -2.3%.

harpreet: quick hypothesis: batch_packing + aggressive int4 reduces per-token memory footprint but increases KV-slot churn/fragmentation under mixed request lengths; fragmentation + smaller slot_reserve -> higher transient peaks -> OOMs.

noah: repro steps I used locally:```
redwood deploy --model sparkline-13b --quant-profile int4 --batch-packing true --max_new_tokens 64 --microbatch 4
abtest run --rps 30 --seq_len 256 --duration 10m
```
that reproduces OOMs within a couple of minutes at ~0.8 concurrency.

toni: when I lowered microbatch to 2 the OOM frequency dropped but latency SLOs breached (p95 went up). So it's a tradeoff.

lucy: options: revert to int8 for canary (safer), or keep int4 but increase slot_reserve and enable kv_trim/soft_evict to reduce fragmentation spikes. Also consider raising max_new_tokens default for this model to avoid tiny-maxgen pathological cases.

harpreet: agree. Immediate action: rollback canary to int8 to stop customer-facing OOMs; medium-term: run focused mem-frag bench and triage quant pack heuristics.

toni: I'll roll back canary and pin Sparkline default max_new_tokens=256 for now.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated by toni -> sparkline-13b v1.1 (target cluster: gpu-pool-3).

lucy: quick config snippet I want to test next (will run in isolated canary):```json
{
  "quant_profile": "int4",
  "batch_packing": true,
  "microbatch": 2,
  "kv_trim_threshold": 0.8,
  "soft_evict": true,
  "slot_reserve": 0.15
}
```

noah: good. add the bench script to reproduce mem-frag:```
./bench_mem_frag.sh --model sparkline-13b --rps 40 --mix "{short:60,long:40}" --duration 15m
```

harpreet: created ticket INF-4891 with plan + artifacts: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4891 :thumbsup:

toni: thanks — I'll follow up with canary logs and attach the failing traces to INF-4891.

lucy: follow-up TODOs in ticket: 1) run mem-frag bench across slot_reserve {0.1,0.15,0.2} 2) run int8 vs int4 quality/eval suite 3) test pack heuristics (no-pack for short requests)

harpreet: assigning to toni/lucy. once we confirm a kv_trim+soft_evict remedy, we can re-enable int4 canary and slowly reduce max_new_tokens default if quality & stability hold. :thumbsup:
